The conclusion is therefore qualitative, based on a mix of procedural-success evidence and substantial evidence of continuing repression and institutional fragility.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/thailand/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Thailand improved from “Not Free” to “Partly Free” because of the competitive 2023 election and formation of a new governing coalition, but unelected senators still blocked the most-voted party from power and civil liberties remained constrained.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.8","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"June 17, 2024","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand","summary":"Thai media could still criticize government policy and report corruption, which is a real positive sign for democratic resilience.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.6","4B.3"]},{"title":"Thailand","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"June 17, 2024","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/thailand","summary":"The same report says media freedom stayed constrained by elites, self-censorship persisted around the military and judiciary, and Pheu Thai’s coalition with military-backed parties eroded trust and democratic optimism.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.6","4B.3","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand: New Government Slow to Protect Rights","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/thailand-new-government-slow-protect-rights","summary":"HRW said the Srettha government had not made serious rights reforms, while conservative institutions had already blocked Move Forward from forming a government. That indicates weak democratic repair at the start of 2024.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.1","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand’s 2024 report page","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024 report page","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/thailand","summary":"HRW says the Pheu Thai-led government pledged rights protection but continued past patterns of repression and prosecutions, so the year did not produce a clear democratic deepening.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","4B.6"]},{"title":"Thai king endorses Paetongtarn Shinawatra as prime minister","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 18, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/thai-king-endorses-paetongtarn-shinawatra-as-prime-minister-3576565","summary":"After Srettha’s removal, parliament elected Paetongtarn and the king formally endorsed her two days later. That shows constitutional succession and a non-coup transfer of executive authority.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Thai politics braces for shakeup after court dismisses PM Srettha Thavisin","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 13-14, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judgment-day-for-thai-pm-srettha-as-court-rules-on-dismissal-case-3570233","summary":"Reuters said the Constitutional Court dismissed Srettha for an ethics violation tied to a cabinet appointment, and that the ruling threatened a coalition shakeup. This is negative for democratic stability because it shows fragility and elite capture risks, even though the transfer remained constitutional.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"Victory for Same-Sex Marriage in Thailand","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"June 18, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/victory-same-sex-marriage-thailand","summary":"Thailand’s Senate approved same-sex marriage under Srettha’s government, which is a concrete legislative rights gain and one of the clearest positive institutional outcomes of 2024.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.7"]},{"title":"Thailand: Last-Ditch Effort for Tak Bai Massacre Justice","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"May 1, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/01/thailand-last-ditch-effort-tak-bai-massacre-justice","summary":"Continued impunity for the Tak Bai case showed that minority protection and accountability for state abuses remained weak, which undercuts any claim that democratic resilience had broadly strengthened.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.7","4B.4","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thailand: Investigate Detained Youth Activist’s Death","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"May 23, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/23/thailand-investigate-detained-youth-activists-death","summary":"Hundreds of monarchy critics remained in pretrial detention, which is evidence that dissent was still being suppressed rather than normalized into a healthier democratic order.","question_ids":["4B.10","4B.3","4B.5","4B.6","4B.7"]}]}
